integrity: The algebraic proof is explicit and the included checker is reproducible. The claim is a sharpness witness derived from a published EAP identity; its value and novelty warrant independent review.
scientific_limitations: Exact boundary result only for a three-string Pauli subspace at N=4m; no classification for all supports with D=N/4 or larger, and no conclusion about thermodynamic phases.
title: Sharp boundary for antipodal-pair eigenstate classification
